subject: Request: technical sprint & architecture review — Novaq integration
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Ava Robins <ava@novaq.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-15T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: technical sprint & architecture review — Novaq integration

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Based on the notes (attached) it sounds like a focused technical deep-dive will help unblock the architecture questions your platform team raised — KV cache behavior, multi-region routing, and data-retention controls for inference logs.

Proposed outcome: a 75-minute session that produces a short mutual action plan (owners + next steps). Proposed agenda (suggested):
- 5m introductions & goals
- 20m architecture walkthrough (Novaq current infra)
- 25m Redwood runtime deep-dive (routing, batching, cache semantics)
- 20m integration Q/A and next milestones
- 5m confirm owners & follow-ups

Available slots next week (PT):
- Tue 20 Apr, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed 21 Apr, 14:00–15:15 PT
- Thu 22 Apr, 09:00–10:15 PT

Can you confirm which slot works and which of your engineers will join (names/roles)? I’ve attached the discovery notes and a short agenda PDF for you to share.

If those windows don’t work we can propose alternatives — we’ll also loop Ben (AE) on the scheduling thread.

Thanks,
Diego
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, redwood-deepdive-agenda.pdf

To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-15T18:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: technical sprint & architecture review — Novaq integration

Diego —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Tom (Platform Lead) and I reviewed the slots; Wed 21 Apr at 14:00 PT would be ideal, but Tom is traveling and likely in transit until 15:00 PT. Could we instead do Thu 22 Apr, 09:00 PT? That would include Tom (remote), me (product), and our SRE, Marcus Li (marcus.li@novaq.ai).

Also attaching a short set of prelim questions from our infra team (SOC2 scoping + log retention). If you could confirm whether Redwood can present the logging retention options and what audit evidence we can share during the session, that would be great.

Thanks —
Ava
Head of Product, Novaq
attachments: novaq-prelim-questions.docx

Ava —

Thanks for confirming. Thu 22 Apr, 09:00 PT is locked on our side. Calendar invite with conferencing + agenda has been sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-novaq-deepdive

Confirmed Redwood attendees:
- Diego Fernandez (Sales Engineer) — architecture mapping / integration owner
- Hannah Schmitt (Solutions Engineer) — runtime, KV cache, logging retention + audit artifacts
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — rollout & post-demo milestones
- Ben Carter (AE) — commercial owner

Confirmed Novaq attendees:
- Ava Robins (Head of Product)
- Tom Ellis (Platform Lead) — remote
- Marcus Li (SRE / infra owner)

Attachments included in the invite: redwood-deepdive-agenda.pdf, discovery-notes.pdf. I’ll prepare 2 slides showing our logging retention options and a short checklist of SOC2 evidence we can surface during the call (we won’t share sensitive artifacts in the call, but we can reference the certs and SOC2 report availability and the audit path).

Pre-call ask for Novaq: please share a short network diagram (VPC + egress paths to Redwood endpoints) and the prelim questions doc you attached — that will let Hannah tailor the retention & audit section to your environment.

If Tom confirms he is joining from APAC and the timezone looks tight, we can drop a brief 15-min follow-up — but plan for the 75-min slot for full coverage.

See you Thursday.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
